		<item>
		<title>The Longtail of Incarceration Unfolds in Gil Batle&#8217;s Surreal Narratives</title>
		<link>https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2026/07/gil-batle-porcelain-plate-paintings/</link>
		
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[Grace Ebert]]></dc:creator>
		<pubDate>Fri, 10 Jul 2026 16:03:05 +0000</pubDate>
				<category><![CDATA[Art]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[birds]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[fish]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[Gil Batle]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[incarceration]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[narrative]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[painting]]></category>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://www.thisiscolossal.com/?p=475745</guid>

					<description><![CDATA[<p><img src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-1.jpg" alt="The Longtail of Incarceration Unfolds in Gil Batle&#8217;s Surreal Narratives" />The lively flora and fauna of a tiny Filipino island commingle with harrowing memories of California prisons in the surreal works of Gil Batle.</p>
<p>Do stories and artists like this matter to you? Become a <a href="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/members">Colossal Member</a> today and support independent arts publishing for as little as $7 per month. The article <a href="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2026/07/gil-batle-porcelain-plate-paintings/">The Longtail of Incarceration Unfolds in Gil Batle&#8217;s Surreal Narratives</a> appeared first on <a href="https://www.thisiscolossal.com">Colossal</a>.</p>
]]></description>
										<content:encoded><![CDATA[<img src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-1.jpg" alt="The Longtail of Incarceration Unfolds in Gil Batle&#8217;s Surreal Narratives" />


<p>The lively flora and fauna of a tiny Filipino island commingle with harrowing memories of California prisons in the surreal works of <a href="https://www.instagram.com/gilbatle/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Gil Batle</a>. Entirely self-taught, Batle honed his skills while incarcerated over the course of 25 years, drawing and eventually tattooing in a clandestine practice. Today, he&#8217;s immigrated to his parents&#8217; native country, where he continues to reflect on the decades he spent in confinement.</p>



<p>Batle&#8217;s <em>Double Life</em> is a new body of work that explores these dual experiences. On white porcelain plates, the artist renders strange, unsettling compositions in which violence and a desire for freedom pervade every inch. Bird cages—common symbols for incarceration— are aplenty, while chains, barbs, and shivs haunt the scenes. </p>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1073" height="797" src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-5.jpg" alt="a white ceramic plate with two boars and tusks curled up with barbed wire" class="wp-image-475754" srcset="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-5.jpg 1073w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-5-640x475.jpg 640w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-5-960x713.jpg 960w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-5-768x570.jpg 768w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1073px) 100vw, 1073px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">&#8220;Barbirusa&#8221; (2025), acrylic on ceramic plate, 9 x 12 inches</figcaption></figure>



<p>Utilizing such a commonplace, fragile, and even prized material, Batle sets a poignant backdrop for considering his blue acrylic paintings. The delicate porcelain both nods to the precarity and breakable nature of life, while also symbolizing traditional ideas of civility and propriety. Juxtaposing these domestic objects with scenes rife with struggle and brutality offers uncanny insight into one of humanity&#8217;s continually barbarous acts.</p>



<p><em>Double Life</em> is on view through August 21 at New York&#8217;s <a href="https://riccomaresca.viewingrooms.com/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Ricco/Maresca</a>, a contemporary gallery representing outsider, self-taught, and folk artists.</p>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1894" height="1240" src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-7.jpg" alt="a white porcelain plate painted with a soldier surrounded by birds and cages" class="wp-image-475756" srcset="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-7.jpg 1894w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-7-640x419.jpg 640w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-7-960x629.jpg 960w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-7-768x503.jpg 768w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-7-1536x1006.jpg 1536w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1894px) 100vw, 1894px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">&#8220;Bird Catcher&#8221; (2026), acrylic on ceramic plate, 7 3/4 x 12 inches</figcaption></figure>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1314" height="1295" src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-8.jpg" alt="a white ceramic plate with a blue painting of a tree cut near the base with a rope tied to the ground surrounded by a moat" class="wp-image-475757" srcset="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-8.jpg 1314w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-8-640x631.jpg 640w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-8-960x946.jpg 960w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-8-768x757.jpg 768w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1314px) 100vw, 1314px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">&#8220;Tethered&#8221; (2024), acrylic on ceramic plate, 8 x 8 inches</figcaption></figure>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="1246" height="1498" src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-6.jpg" alt="a white ceramic plate with a blue painting of a headless figure and a headless pig. the pig is handing the man his head" class="wp-image-475755" srcset="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-6.jpg 1246w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-6-640x769.jpg 640w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-6-960x1154.jpg 960w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-6-768x923.jpg 768w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 1246px) 100vw, 1246px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">&#8220;The Butcher&#8221; (2025), acrylic on ceramic plate, 10 3/4 x 8 3/4 inches</figcaption></figure>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2000" height="1993" src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-4.jpg" alt="a white ceramic plate with blue acrylic of a tattooed pig" class="wp-image-475753" srcset="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-4.jpg 2000w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-4-640x638.jpg 640w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-4-960x957.jpg 960w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-4-150x150.jpg 150w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-4-768x765.jpg 768w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-4-1536x1531.jpg 1536w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2000px) 100vw, 2000px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">&#8220;Tattooed Pig&#8221; (2025), acrylic on ceramic plate, 9 x 9 inches</figcaption></figure>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2000" height="1505" src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-2.jpg" alt="a white ceramic plate with a blue painting of a man on a bull with its hooves nailed to a large rocker" class="wp-image-475759" srcset="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-2.jpg 2000w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-2-640x482.jpg 640w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-2-960x722.jpg 960w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-2-768x578.jpg 768w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/batle-2-1536x1156.jpg 1536w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2000px) 100vw, 2000px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">&#8220;Rice Field Rocker&#8221; (2024), acrylic on ceramic plate, 11 x 14 1/2 inches</figcaption></figure>

		<item>
		<title>International Aerial Photographer of the Year Contest Highlights the World from Above</title>
		<link>https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2026/07/international-aerial-photographer-of-the-year-contest-2026/</link>
		
		<dc:creator><![CDATA[Kate Mothes]]></dc:creator>
		<pubDate>Thu, 09 Jul 2026 22:43:00 +0000</pubDate>
				<category><![CDATA[Nature]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[Photography]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[aerial]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[contests]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[deserts]]></category>
		<category><![CDATA[landscapes]]></category>
		<guid isPermaLink="false">https://www.thisiscolossal.com/?p=475702</guid>

					<description><![CDATA[<p><img src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-2.jpg" alt="International Aerial Photographer of the Year Contest Highlights the World from Above" />See the 101 top photos submitted from around the world.</p>
<p>Do stories and artists like this matter to you? Become a <a href="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/members">Colossal Member</a> today and support independent arts publishing for as little as $7 per month. The article <a href="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/2026/07/international-aerial-photographer-of-the-year-contest-2026/">International Aerial Photographer of the Year Contest Highlights the World from Above</a> appeared first on <a href="https://www.thisiscolossal.com">Colossal</a>.</p>
]]></description>
										<content:encoded><![CDATA[<img src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-2.jpg" alt="International Aerial Photographer of the Year Contest Highlights the World from Above" />


<p>For a structure that was completed nearly 90 years ago, San Francisco&#8217;s Golden Gate Bridge possesses a kind of timeless modernity. It&#8217;s been the subject of countless photographs, often seen in the background from Baker Beach or from the overlook in Marin County. Its towers rise 500 feet from the roadway, but we typically can only see the structures from that level. For photographer Marcin Zając, a drone&#8217;s-eye view revealed a unique perspective of this iconic landmark.</p>



<p>Zając&#8217;s image is one of 101 finalists in the 2026 <a href="https://www.internationalaerialphotographer.com/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">International Aerial Photographer of the Year</a>, marking the second year of the competition. Photographers around the world submitted nearly 1,600 entries, with the top honor awarded to Azim Khan Ronnie, who draws on his background in journalism to capture human activities like fishing and harvesting crops.</p>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2000" height="1333" src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-7.jpg" alt="an aerial photograph of agricultural workers harvesting red chili" class="wp-image-475709" srcset="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-7.jpg 2000w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-7-640x427.jpg 640w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-7-960x640.jpg 960w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-7-768x512.jpg 768w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-7-1536x1024.jpg 1536w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2000px) 100vw, 2000px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">Azim Khan Ronnie (Bangladesh), &#8220;Harvesting Red Chili&#8221;</figcaption></figure>



<p>Photographs considered for the competition range from drone views to shots taken from airplanes or the tops of buildings. Subject matter ranges from erupting volcanoes and geological phenomena to architecture and cultural events. See the top 101 photos on the contest&#8217;s <a href="https://internationalaerialphotographer.com/" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">website</a>.</p>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2000" height="1333" src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-14.jpg" alt="an aerial photograph of a bird standing in the center of a round pond surrounded by red foliage" class="wp-image-475735" srcset="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-14.jpg 2000w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-14-640x427.jpg 640w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-14-960x640.jpg 960w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-14-768x512.jpg 768w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-14-1536x1024.jpg 1536w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2000px) 100vw, 2000px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">Vitaly Golovatyuk (Russia)</figcaption></figure>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2000" height="1125" src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-1.jpg" alt="an aerial photograph of an island landscape with a full-circle rainbow framing the view" class="wp-image-475703" srcset="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-1.jpg 2000w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-1-640x360.jpg 640w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-1-960x540.jpg 960w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-1-768x432.jpg 768w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-1-1536x864.jpg 1536w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2000px) 100vw, 2000px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">Paolo Lazzarotti (Italy), &#8220;Complete Rainbow&#8221;</figcaption></figure>



<figure class="wp-block-image size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="2000" height="1334" src="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-12.jpg" alt="an aerial photograph of myriad ridges of a desert landscape" class="wp-image-475714" srcset="https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-12.jpg 2000w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-12-640x427.jpg 640w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-12-960x640.jpg 960w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-12-768x512.jpg 768w, https://www.thisiscolossal.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/aerialphotog-12-1536x1025.jpg 1536w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 2000px) 100vw, 2000px" /><figcaption class="wp-element-caption">Paweł Jagiełło (Poland), &#8220;The Valley of Forgotten Rivers&#8221;</figcaption></figure>
